pd_test: Add a delay between iterations on hard reset test After performing an iteration of hard reset, DUT may continue to negotiate a higher >5V voltage. Some check on the next iteration will see DUT/PDTester being in some transitional state and fail. This CL add a delay between iterations so the >5V negotiation completes before the next iteration. BUG=b:131840808 TEST=Ran firmware_PDResetHard multiple time and passed consistently. goofy: Read VPD data from command instead of sysfs Goofy tries to read VPD data from sysfs, which should be fine in most of the cases. But for factory, we may have RW VPD looks like "factory.end_SMT", which the dot is considered as illegal by VPD kernel driver, so the VPD sentence won't be loaded into sysfs, leading to an end that Goofy doesn't know the stage has ended. This CL utilizes self.dut.vpd.live instead of self.dut.vpd.boot to force VPD read from command tools, which is less efficient but should be still acceptable in factory flow. BUG=b:135048597 TEST=Run the following commands on DUT: `vpd -i RW_VPD -s factory.end_SMT=True` `factory test-list generic_main` `factory_restart -a` and see SMT stage is being skipped Change-Id: I4ef59947836beb3119bc7d9833a31c9fcbce1c95 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1686801 Tested-by: Fei Shao <fshao@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Fei Shao <fshao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org>

tast: Drop broken support of non-test images. The tast command used to push local_test_runner even if -buildlocalrunner is not set when it is not found on the device. This was meant to support non-test devices, but today just pushing local_test_runner and test bundles are not enough to run tests on non-test devices; for example, all software dependencies are unavailable due to missing /usr/local/etc/tast_use_flags.txt, some tests depend on helper C binaries that are only available on test images, and so on. This change drops broken support of non-test images to simplify logic around building and pushing files. BUG=chromium:970127 BUG=chromium:970126 TEST=fast_build.sh -T Change-Id: I18773cf46a752bcb7c8d7c409250d702726a9f6a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1683697 Tested-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Keigo Oka <oka@chromium.org>
